title: A Computational Audit of Demographic Association Encoding in ClinicalBERT Language Predictions

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual substitution of racial demographic descriptors (Black, Hispanic, Asian, White) in clinical sentence templates, using Log Probability Bias Analysis (LPBA) and Masked Language Model (MLM) probing to measure shifts in masked token probabilities for behavioral, evaluative, and agency words, benchmarked against actual training corpus frequencies.

Counterfactual substitution of gender demographic descriptors (Male, Female) in clinical sentence templates, using LPBA and MLM probing to measure probability shifts for behavioral, evaluative, and agency words, benchmarked against actual training corpus frequencies.

Analyzing masked token probability distributions across 8 intersectional race-gender demographic combinations (e.g., Black Female, White Male) to identify compounding representational harms (stereotyping, erasure, demeaning) that race-level or gender-level analysis alone would obscure.
